new_page.description: Whalley, Surrey houses for sale: 81 listed in October 2026, monthly sales and how Whalley compares with Surrey. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®.
new_page.h1: Whalley Houses for Sale | Surrey Real Estate

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Whalley. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Whalley, Surrey: 81 houses listed at the end of October 2026 and 4 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 5%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 7 of 15 Surrey communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Surrey total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Whalley fell from 86 in June to 81 in October (−5.8%), and 14 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 7.8% of Surrey’s 1,033 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Whalley?
Whalley also had 604 condos and townhomes listed and 42 sold in October, against 81 houses listed.

blocks.text: Whalley home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

26 houses sold in Whalley with a median price of $1,305,000 (the middle half sold between $1,105,000 and $1,637,500), taking a median of 28 days to sell at 95.4% of the last list price; 8% sold above list. They had a median $480 per square foot, a median year built of 1990 and a median lot of 7,852 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Whalley?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 81 houses listed in Whalley. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Whalley a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Whalley had a sales ratio of 5%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Whalley from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 14 houses sold in Whalley over those 5 months, out of 464 in all of Surrey.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Whalley?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Whalley sell for?
faq.a: 26 houses sold in Whalley between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,305,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Whalley?
faq.a: The median was 28 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 95.4% of the last list price (8% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
